comparison.objective: Extract exactly one chip from an open packet and place it on a plate while retaining the others.
comparison.physical_skill: Selective grasping in clutter, packet stabilization, constrained extraction, and gentle placement.
comparison.success_condition: One chip clears and rests on the plate with hands clear; packet displacement, loss, or any second chip leaving containment permanently fails.
comparison.reason: This tests selective retrieval and retention from a container. Fragment recovery is only a generic shared primitive; the candidate must first create four fragments through controlled impact fracture and preserve four threaded inserts before collecting every tang.
